content.short: OtoCo is a community-governed, open-source Web3 platform that lets users form and control legal entities onchain.
content.description: OtoCo is a community-governed, open-source Web3 platform that lets users form and manage legal entities directly from their wallets. It ports legal entities across multiple jurisdictions onto the blockchain, enabling instant incorporation, automated funding, and flexible, liquid governance. By turning companies into code, OtoCo builds blockchain-native organizations that empower anyone—anywhere—to pursue entrepreneurship with fewer barriers and greater autonomy.
